note: A restored Saab A 32 Lansen stands as a gate-guard monument at the roundabout by Halmstad City Airport.
Karins sten is a legend rock by Moasjön in Hjortsberga, where a girl named Karin is said to have climbed clear of wolves.
Högarör is a Bronze Age cairn on a ridge east of Lagan, south of Ljungby, linked to a legend of treasure guarded by a dragon.
Stenudden is the outer point of a stone ridge on northern Bolmsö, told as the remains of a giants' bridge toward the mainland.
Trollsmeden i Nockarp is a legend site near Agunnaryd, where a strange smith is said to have left a lump of pure gold.
Trollträdet is the remains of a tree in Torpa forest where people once drove toothache and other pains into the trunk.

other_sources.title: 39. Mästertjuven Tullbergs grotta och gran - Sagobygden

note: Tullbergs grotta is a small cave in the woods near Göteryd, said to have been a hideout for the thief Carl Gustaf Tullberg.

photos: File:Carl IX shaft, Sala Silver mine, Sala, Sweden.JPG
File:Drottning Christinas schakt vid Sala silvergruva.jpg
File:Karl XI schakt vid Sala silvergruva.jpg
File:Queen Christina shaft, Sala Silver mine, Sala, Sweden.JPG
note: Sala silvergruva is the historic silver mine southwest of Sala, worked from the 15th century and now open as a visitor mine.
Kungshall is the bastion on Stumholmen in Karlskrona where one of Sweden's official salute batteries stands.
Sammilsdal, called Gropen, is an ice-age kettle hole in central Leksand used for the town's midsummer pole and, for many years, Himlaspelet.

other_sources.title: Provtagningar av vatten i Sandakällan | Nacka kommun

note: Sandakällan is a spring in a gravel esker by Sandasjön in Nacka, where people collect cold groundwater.
Sankt Göransporten is a medieval gate in Visby's north wall, the passage out toward the old St George's leper hospital.

wikipedia.title: Sankt Hans och Sankt Pers kyrkoruiner

note: Sankt Hans is one of two 13th-century churches built together in central Visby, now a ruin enclosing a garden.

photos: File:SAS McDonnell Douglas MD-81 (DC-9-81) OY-KHO KvW-1.jpg
note: This field at Gottröra is where SAS flight 751 crash-landed on 27 December 1991 after both engines failed, with everyone aboard surviving.
Schisshyttans herrgård is an 18th-century slag-stone manor by Lake Skissen, at a former ironworks northwest of Smedjebacken.
Scoutmonumentet in Slottsskogen, Gothenburg, was raised in 1959 in memory of Ebbe Lieberath, founder of Swedish scouting.
Segelbäcken gamla kvarn is an old mill with a surviving wheel on a hillside by Lake Krön outside Vimmerby.
Segeltorps luftvärnsställning is a Second World War anti-aircraft battery on a hill in northern Segeltorp, with gun pits and a sealed bunker.

other_sources.title: SLM A9-368 - Sibro kvarn - Sörmlands museums samlingar

note: Sibro kvarn is a mill and dam at the outlet of Lake Båven, now also a bathing place and overnight stop.
Siggamåla skvaltkvarn is a small horizontal water mill from 1822, kept working by Almundsryds hembygdsförening near Ryd.
Sikhjälma gammelhamn is a restored early fishing harbour on the Hållnäs coast, with boathouses rebuilt by the village association.
Silfhytteå bruk is a closed ironworks between lakes Grycken and Fullen, with a restored blast furnace, roasting furnace and a disused lock.
Sjötorp locks 7 and 8 are a paired lock on the Göta Canal, built in 1822, with a combined drop of about 4.6 metres.
Sjötorps kvarn in Äspered is a mill, saw, smithy and old shop by Lake Tolken, at the local hembygdsgård.
Sjötorpsfortet is a First World War fort of the Södra Fronten above Drevviken in Skogås, with a long trench wall and bunkers.
Sjöänd skans, fort 118, is a restored Second World War strongpoint in Glaskogen near Årjäng, built to block a route from occupied Norway.
Skams gator is a ravine on Seloberg in Sund, Ydre, on a trail that also passes the thief Selo's cave.
Skans 113 Borgvik, called OH Hatten, is a Second World War strongpoint near Borgvik in Värmland, used as a signals post toward the Norwegian border.
Skans 4 is a guided military site near Tingstäde on Gotland where several branches of the armed forces are shown together.
Skans Hamrafjäll is a small roadside bunker position by Hamrafjället in western Härjedalen, with two bunkers that can be looked into.
Skansahålet is a berry-rich spot with a small cave in the woods near Lilla Edet, visited as a short stop.
The skansar in Traryds hembygdspark are historic earthworks beside the local animal park in Traryd.
Skansen Alanäs is a Second World War fort on a hill by Alanäset along Vildmarksvägen, with a marked trail through bunkers facing occupied Norway.
The city quarters at Skansen on Djurgården are a reconstructed older town street with workshops, a bakery, an apothecary and a printing house.
Skansen Sjulsåsen is a Second World War fort along Vildmarksvägen, with bunkers and anti-tank obstacles open to walk through.
Skansen Storån is a Second World War fort by the river along Vildmarksvägen, with bunkers and the remains of a roadblock.
Skansport is a gate cut through Visby's town wall in 1879 beside an early-18th-century battery, with a view over the harbour.
Skansudde fyrplats is a lighthouse station on Kronholmen at Västergarn, Gotland, with a preserved 1890s light and a concrete tower from 1936.
Skanörs stubbamölla is a post mill on the west side of Skanör, Skåne's oldest surviving example and a protected building since 1975.
Skavnäsets kapell is a 1940s chapel, shaped like a mine headframe, on the burial ground at Högbergsfältet by Lake Yngen in Persberg.
The pin on the shore at Åhus marks a shipwreck that from land shows only as a pair of stones on the bottom, with the wreck itself further out.
Skillnabo is a cleared early-20th-century feldspar quarry in the woods at Östra Frölunda, with a raft on the water-filled pit.
Skolhusfortet is a trench line of the Södra Fronten in Trångsund, where the main bunker lies inside the prison grounds and is closed.

photos: File:Skottorps slott Hallandia antiqua et hodierna 1753.jpg
note: Skottorps slott is an Empire manor in Skummeslöv, Laholm, a protected building since 1986 and now privately owned.
Skrape-Finas backstuga is a preserved crofter's cottage near Dagsås, looking out toward the lake and Öströö manor.
Essljungs gruva is a quartz and mica quarry in Väne-Ryr, known for amazonite, a short distance southeast of the larger Skuleboda pit.
The skurverk at Jordhamn is Sweden's only surviving wind-powered mill for grinding limestone slabs, built in 1905 and protected since 2013.
The skvaltkvarn at Svalilt is a small water mill in the woods of Breared, of the kind local farmers once used to grind grain.
Skvatterbergets gruva is an old iron mine south of Borlänge, fenced off after a rockfall and closed to the public because of the collapse risk.
Skvin kalkbruk is a disused lime works in the woods of Leksand, an overgrown industrial site off the main roads.
